name: Door County KOA Holiday
note: KOA Holiday at 9245 Lovers Lane, Brussels; full-hookup and water/electric RV sites, pull-throughs. RV sites $38-93 a night before tax for a mid-May 2027 weeknight on KOA's booking form. RV Life 4.5*, $$$$. --Claude
